description: Read the app's clock as the Clock tool (@buoy-gg/clock) sees it: the time the app reads now, whether it is overridden (running, frozen or sped up), how far it is from real time, and the pending app timers a jump ahead could run. Also lists the app's sign-in tokens seen in its traffic (JWT, PASETO, opaque tokens with an expiry from the login response, session cookies): time left on the app's clock and the server's, who issued them, refreshes, sends after expiry, refresh loops, and the result of a running refresh check. Check this before calling a date, countdown, expiry or sign-out a bug.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

name: get_clock
